item.title: Brooks Koepka gets a fresh start at a familiar place in Torrey Pines
item.description: Torrey Pines looked plenty familiar to Brooks Koepka. The PGA Tour? Not so much. The post Brooks Koepka gets a fresh start at a familiar place in Torrey Pines appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Bill Belichick snubbed by Pro Football Hall of Fame in first year of eligibility, report says
item.description: Six-time Super Bowl champion head coach Bill Belichick didn’t get voted into the Pro Football Hall of Fame in his first year of eligibility, according to a report from ESPN. The post Bill Belichick snubbed by Pro Football Hall of Fame in first year of eligibility, report says appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Patrick Reed is leaving LIV Golf. He can return to the PGA Tour in September
item.description: Patrick Reed is the second major champion to leave Saudi-funded LIV Golf, announcing Wednesday he will spend the rest of the year on the European tour with an eye on returning to the PGA Tour as early as September. The post Patrick Reed is leaving LIV Golf. He can return to the PGA Tour in September appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Two arrested after reported gun incident triggers lockdown at Aiken school
item.description: Two Aiken men were arrested Wednesday morning following a reported gun scare near JD Lever Elementary School that prompted a lockdown and a large law enforcement response. The post Two arrested after reported gun incident triggers lockdown at Aiken school appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Popular and political support growing for ban on cellphones in Georgia high schools
item.description: Georgia high school sophomores are looking ever more likely to lose their phones during the school day in their senior year, as lawmakers consider expanding a ban on personal devices.
